description_en: Queries a list of tables in a database
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb list-tables --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --schema public --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTables

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to create an access credential.

To call the ListTables operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, the RAM user must have the permissions to call the UseSecret or GetSecretValue operation on the ARN of the access credential
parameters.help_zh:
访问凭证。通过CreateSecret接口创建。

通过子账号访问此接口时，需要有对此SecretArn的UseSecret或GetSecretValue的权限
parameters.name: secret_arn

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页时返回的最多数目，范围在1～100之间
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The table name pattern for matching. For example, `ab%` specifies to match table names that start with ab
parameters.help_zh: 表名称匹配模式，比如```ab%```表示以ab开头的名称
parameters.name: table_pattern

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
parameters.name: schema

NextToken.description_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists

Status.description_en:
The status of the operation. Valid values:

success
fail
Status.description_zh:
状态，取值说明：
success：成功
fail：失败
